patch_description: Replace the current two-parameter (theta1 rotation / theta2 CRZ-long-range) design—which regressed to 0.72—with the proven 0.80-scoring topology (single shared-parameter rotations + CZ ring + XX-reinforced ring + skip-2 sub-ring + antipodal shortcuts, fastest convergence variant) but apply the recommended minimal 1→2 parameter split: keep all RX/RY/RZ single-qubit rotations sharing one scalar "theta_r", and let the entangling XX interaction use a separate scalar "theta_e". This decouples rotation strength from entanglement strength (addressing the expressivity ceiling) while adding only one extra trainable parameter and reusing the topology, gate count (240) and zero-parameter fixed entanglers (CZ ring, skip-2 ring, antipodal shortcuts) that previously converged fastest (30 steps) at top score.
